Chapter 6565: I Want To See How Deep Your Abyss Is

Chapter 6565: I Want To See How Deep Your Abyss Is

“It is not too late to hand the source of desires over.” Xian Chengtian threatened with his Immortal Killer.

His imperious and arrogant demeanor infuriated Primal Yin Immortal Ghost. His cultivation mattered not; it always seemed he was the one beneath in this relationship.

“Come get it if you can.” He gritted his teeth before dispersing into nothingness.

Spectators thought he had escaped but in reality, space suddenly became darker. Three Immortals also turned dark as if something prevented light from coming.

“What’s happening?” Inhabitants couldn’t see their hands when raised in front of them.

This was worse than just space surrounding them. It turned out to be a bottomless abyss. Overlords couldn’t see the end, let alone weaker cultivators.

Emperors and others became frightened while staring at the abyss, feeling as if they were being pulled inside. Once trapped, there was no coming out.

“Stop looking at it.” Primal ancestors and heaven-slayers warned the others.

Fortunately, the abyss was meant to deal with Xian Chengtian, not Three Immortals. Otherwise, it would have sucked their souls away.

“Buzz.” Xian Chengtian recalled the three dao surrounding Three Immortals. They wrapped around him like armor.

He glowed brightly; his light penetrated the abyss. Others looked up and thought he was a savior delivering them from darkness. Mortals kneeled before the light. Of course, they had no idea what was going on.

If Primal Yin Immortal Ghost noted this, his jealousy would erupt again. His opponent was a man resembling an immortal more than anyone else.

Chengtian gazed into the abyss and let his light roam free through countless dimensions. However, it couldn’t reach the end either.

“The abyss. Are you not afraid of a possession?” Chengtian had a serious expression.

However, the ghost no longer answered. Was he a part of the abyss or had he fallen in there?

“This is Fiendish Ground’s abyss...” Other overlords became startled and didn’t dare to set foot inside.

They didn’t fully understand this abyss but knew it was connected to Fiendish Ground. Thus, entering was perilous.

Everything would be fine as long as they didn’t gaze into it. However, Chengtian wanted the source of desires.

“We’ll see how deep your abyss is.” He jumped into it without any hesitation.

“Boom!” His light became fiery during the delve, attempting to fill it up.

His cultivation was immense. If he chose to fall to the darkness, he could swallow Three Immortals in the blink of an eye. Alas, his inferno couldn’t light up the abyss in its entirety.

“Die!” He activated his Immortal Killer to the limit and performed a thrust surpassing the limit of speed.

“Rumble!” He fully displayed his immortal potential but couldn’t pierce through despite the help of his ultimate weapon.

“Up!” He stopped and intuition told him it was time to get out.
